name: Rei
source:
Rei is a witness in the case against mvdy. She is a huge fan of Chicken Shoot Gold and VS, and she purchased Discord Nitro for pichuis, mvdy, and Stealphie.

[spoiler]Rei is the daughter of the chief justice. Her full name is Shuichi Greyerl, and despite claiming to be rich, she is actually dirt poor, as her father took back all the money he had given her. Her brother is Jean Greyerl, the chief justice's son who was inflicted with Incuritis. To help her brother, she attempted to smuggle a Borginian cocoon using her father's name and resources, but her attempt was unsuccessful.[/spoiler]
